column1: # unit-464mysites — MY OWN 20 reason lines, hand-read for whether each one names a CONSUMPTION SITE
# Filed 2026-11-04, STOP fire, in its own commit, BEFORE any grader in this unit exists. The commit
# order is the evidence and is checkable with `git log --diff-filter=A` over this path against the
# commit that first reads it.
# SUBJECT   docs/research/unit-464cons-2026-11-04/HAND-CONS.tsv @ its own add-commit 2fd49cd7
# RULE      LEG-CLASS-CONVENTION.md v1.9 §2.1k (Theseus), whose §4 ran this same census on HIS table
# ───────────────────────── THIS READ IS NOT BLIND AND I AM NOT DRESSING IT AS ONE ─────────────────
#   I wrote every row of HAND-CONS.tsv myself this morning and have read all 20. This is a census of
#   my own prose, by me. Its only claim to value is that the question below is NOT the question I was
#   asking when I wrote those rows, and that the thresholds were registered in PRE-REGISTRATION.md
#   (P2SYM: >=5 of 7 A rows name no site; >=8 of 12 R rows name a site) before this file existed.
#   Declared cheap in the pre-registration. The leg that is not cheap is P3REACH.
# ───────────────────────── THE QUESTION, AND THE TRAP IN ASKING IT OF MY TABLE ────────────────────
#   §2.1k: a CONSUMPTION SITE is where the selection's value LANDS — a PUBLISHED-FIGURE, a printed
#   REASON-STRING, or a PREDICATE/gate.
#   My TSV carries a dedicated `consumer` column, so EVERY one of my 20 rows names a consumer
#   EXPRESSION. If "names a consumer expression" counted, this leg would be green by construction at
#   20 of 20 and would measure nothing. So the column below is keyed strictly on the LANDING SITE,
#   and a row that names only how the selection is NARROWED (`[0]`, newest-first, `.find`) is `no`.
#   names_site   yes | no    does the reason name a place where the value LANDS?
#   site_kind    PREDICATE | PUBLISHED-FIGURE | REASON-STRING | -        (only when names_site=yes)
#   argues_from  SITE | REDUCTION | CALL-SHAPE | SUBJECT-COMMENT
#                  SITE            a landing site, per above
#                  REDUCTION       how the selection is narrowed to a value — a property of the
#                                  consumer, so sounder than CALL-SHAPE, but still not a site
#                  CALL-SHAPE      which flags the call carries — the key §2.1j/§2.1k declare
#                                  known-wrong before it is written
#                  SUBJECT-COMMENT the subject's own comment about itself
#   A THIRD KEY IS PRESENT AND HIS BINARY DOES NOT PARTITION MY ROWS. His §4 splits his rows into
#   "names a site" and "rests on the call's own shape". Mine need REDUCTION as well, and it is not a
#   rounding detail: a reduction-keyed argument is a claim about the consumer, which is the right
#   kind of thing, and it still does not say where the value goes.
site
